about.metaDescription: Meet Marketing House — an officially registered full-service agency with three branches across Egypt.
about.title: The house where brands grow
about.story: We started with a simple belief: every business in Egypt deserves world-class marketing. Today Marketing House is a full-service agency with branches in Giza, Cairo and Assiut, and a team that blends strategy, creativity and numbers — to build brands that last and grow.
about.mission: Help businesses reach their audience intelligently and turn attention into real sales and sustainable growth.
about.vision: To be the agency Egyptian brands choose when they're serious about growth.
